findings.text: Companies House records show the company's status as dissolved, and this is the only high-severity red flag identified.
The company was incorporated on 5 August 2015 and ceased on 26 September 2017, at an age of 2.1 years (783 days).
There is 1 current officer, a director, PERSON 343, appointed on 5 August 2015, and no other officers are recorded.
The register records 1 current person with significant control, PERSON 344, with ownership of shares of 75 to 100 percent.
The overdue status of the accounts and the confirmation statement is unknown, as their next due dates and last made-up-to dates are not recorded.
No charges are registered against the company, and Companies House holds no insolvency record for it.
PERSON 343 has no other appointments on record, so no other companies were found for the current director.
No registered office address changes or officer appointments or resignations were filed since 24 October 2025.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 460 (91000461) is dissolved, having ceased on 26 September 2017, about 2.1 years after its incorporation on 5 August 2015.
